questions.questionTextKo: 균형 잡힌 점심을 만들기 위해 음식 세 가지를 고르고 그 이유를 설명해 보세요.
questions.gradingContext: The picture presents several foods including salad, grapes, cheese, a hot dog, fries, and a donut. More than one balanced combination is reasonable if the learner explains the choices.
questions.modelAnswer: I would choose salad, grapes, and cheese because they give me vegetables, fruit, and another food group.
acceptedAnswers: I would choose salad, grapes, and a hot dog because the meal has different kinds of food.

cases.answerText: I would choose salad, grapes, and a hot dog because the meal has different kinds of food.

questions.questionText: Which bird has large round eyes and sits upright?
questions.questionTextKo: 크고 둥근 눈을 가지고 똑바로 앉아 있는 새는 무엇인가요?
questions.gradingContext: The picture shows a brown owl with large round eyes, a short hooked beak, and an upright body. The bird is an owl.
questions.modelAnswer: The bird is an owl.
